basis: Editable original concept dimensions in millimetres in the current Fusion chassis frame. All upper structure, loaded CG allocation, motor limits, service volumes and camera rays are engineering hypotheses.

cameras.tagLoss: Hold loaded and braked. Resume only after a consistent fresh pose or back away within the reserved corridor.

interfaces: One station operator feeds one registered pipe per release, with the same actor, source and time window in all cases.
Drive and handling share the battery bus; reserve time to stow before leaving the reef.
A lost capture observation inhibits driving and scoring. Remain stopped, reacquire or park empty before the match deadline.

tip-tray.path: Open rear station mouth, passively supported transverse pipe, one tipping bed and a retracting gate, forward gravity delivery.
tip-tray.capture: Station feeds into a rear funnel. Two independent end witnesses must see the pipe seated before drive.
tip-tray.release: Tip to 12 degrees and open the gate after stopped pose confirmation. The 370 mm rail and 55 mm gravity run are from the conditional sweep.
tip-tray.reset: Close the gate and stow only after custody clears. If the pipe bridges the rim, hold still, inhibit the next feed and back out only after clearance.
tip-tray.service: Withdraw the gate drive outward without reaching through the pipe path. A straight downward gate would strike the trough panel; a folding gate needs a new measured sweep.
tip-tray.trade: A single handling bed avoids a second transfer. Its rotating upper sweep and two low sightlines compete.

fixed-rollers.path: Rear station funnel into a fixed high reversible belt, two front pinch rollers eject the transverse pipe across the bumper.
fixed-rollers.capture: Dispenser feeds the fixed channel, belt advances to two end stops, seated sensor inhibits further feed.
fixed-rollers.release: A commanded surface speed draws both ends through a fixed nip and sends the pipe to L1. Wheel slip, spin and actual release remain unmeasured.
fixed-rollers.reset: Brake rollers and confirm both exits clear before permitting another feed. Reverse only on confirmed retained cargo.
fixed-rollers.service: Release belt tension and remove the transverse shaft from the left. This overlaps a driver-side camera service corridor.
fixed-rollers.trade: Eliminates lift and exterior reach. Current overlap, spin uncertainty and finite free-flight accuracy dominate.

split-drop.path: Rear station cradle carries a transverse pipe; a short horizontal slide presents two split supports above the trough; the supports open sideways.
split-drop.capture: Dispenser seats both ends on the split cradle. A left/right support indication and observed end positions permit travel.
split-drop.release: Extend to the registered drop position and splay the two supports sideways. A zero-horizontal-speed drop tests the field condition only.
split-drop.reset: Retract supports on independent clear signals, then retract slide before driving. Failed side opening inhibits the feed and chassis.
split-drop.service: Isolate the slide, pin the cradle, withdraw both side pivots, restore home references and confirm matching separation.
split-drop.trade: Vertical release limits horizontal kinetic energy. The extra slide, two-sided openings and service access increase dependencies.
